card.name: Inside brand drug names
card.fires_on: Middle pieces of brand and biologic drug names in prescribing text, such as LUT-ATHER-A, PAD-CE-V and tremelimumab-act-l. It also fires on a few ordinary words like 'the' and 'of' near drug-label headings.

modes.label: Brand name middle
modes.description: Middle piece of a capitalized brand name that is split into several parts.
modes.example: Do not administer LUT<<ATHER>>A as an intravenous bolus.

modes.label: Enzyme or heading piece
modes.description: Piece inside a drug interaction heading, such as the enzyme name CYP3A.
